mapper.select: SELECT c.`id`, c.`user_email`, c.`item_id`, c.`size`, c.`quantity`, c.`created_at`, si.`item_name`, si.`color`, si.`price`, (SELECT img.`image_path` FROM `cors`.`shop_item_images` img WHERE img.`product_id` = si.`id` LIMIT 1) AS `image_path` FROM `cors`.`carts` c JOIN `cors`.`shop_items` si ON c.`item_id` = si.`id` WHERE c.`user_email` = #{userEmail} ORDER BY c.`created_at` DESC
